test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: If February is called ‘April’, April is called ‘June’, June is called ‘August’, August is called ‘October’, and October is called ‘December’, then in which month do we celebrate Independence Day?
solution:
If 

 
• February is called ‘April’
 
• April is called ‘June’
 
• June is called ‘August’
 
• August is called ‘October’
 
• October is called ‘December’

We celebrate Independence Day in the month of August and August is called ‘October’.

Hence, '**October**' is the correct answer.
